name: What should I wear or bring to a sound bath session at Cave Training?
description: Wear comfortable clothing and bring a yoga mat, blanket, and pillow for a sound bath. Staying hydrated is also recommended.

mainEntity.name: What should I wear or bring to a sound bath session at Cave Training?

acceptedAnswer.text: For a sound bath session, you should wear comfortable, loose-fitting clothing that allows for full relaxation. It's advisable to bring a yoga mat, blanket, and pillow to ensure maximum comfort while lying down for the duration of the session. While we provide a serene environment, personal items can enhance your experience. Consider bringing a water bottle to stay hydrated, as some people find they feel thirsty after a session.
